title: Personal delegation policy
description: The file at ~/.config/skill-collection/delegation.json. Fields and matching: POLICY.md beside this file.

$schema.description: Optional path or URL of this schema, for editors.

version.description: Schema version of the policy file.

autoFallback.description: true lets delegating pick a suitable model outside a rule's choices, unasked, once they are exhausted. Default false: ask first. A rule's own autoFallback wins.

effortDefaults.description: Personal effort for each difficulty when a matching rule names none. Unset difficulties keep delegating's defaults (low, medium, high).

rules.description: Rules for every workflow, tried in order after the dispatching workflow's own rules.

workflows.description: Per-workflow overrides: each key is a workflow's callable name (code-review, implement-spec). Its rules are tried, in order, before the top-level rules.

effort.description: The effort intent delegating uses; each harness maps it to its own control.

name.description: A lower-case identifier: letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens.

rule.description: Matches an agent by role and difficulty; an omitted matcher matches any. Exactly one of order or pool.

role.description: Role names, lower case, words separated by single spaces. A name matches a caller's role equal to it or ending in it as a whole word, ignoring case: reviewer matches spec reviewer.

order.description: Ordered choices: the first suitable available one is used.

pool.description: Unordered choices: delegating picks among the suitable available members. A pool supplies choices, not extra agents.

effort.description: Effort for every choice in this rule. Unset: effortDefaults, then delegating's defaults.

autoFallback.description: Overrides the top-level autoFallback for this rule.

choice.description: Where the model runs (harness, provider or both) and which model (an exact ID or a version-independent family).

harness.description: The agent runtime that runs the model, such as claude-code, codex or opencode.

provider.description: Who serves the model, such as anthropic, openai or zai.

model.description: An exact model ID as the harness or provider takes it (OpenCode: provider/model-id). Never substituted; may name a preview.

family.description: A version-independent family (opus, sol, glm). Resolves to the newest suitable stable model in the live catalog.
